title: Cost-Effective Repository Exploration for Agentic Issue Localization
abstract: arXiv:2608.29675v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Repository exploration is a distinct and costly stage of coding-agent pipelines: before generating a patch, an agent must identify which repository files are likely to matter. We study whether this stage can be delegated to lower-cost models while retaining useful localization quality. Using our IssueLoc-Bench, we evaluate five explorer models under the same read-only interactive interface on 499 SWE-bench Verified-derived tasks and 500 tasks from 153 additional repositories. We measure early candidate discovery, top-three gold-file coverage, strict file-set recovery, agent time, and token usage, with paired instance-level uncertainty and repository-clustered sensitivity analysis. translated_title: 面向智能体问题定位的高性价比代码仓库探索
translated_abstract: 代码仓库探索是编码智能体流水线中一个独立且成本高昂的阶段：在生成补丁之前，智能体必须先识别出仓库中哪些文件可能是重要的。我们研究这一阶段是否可以委托给成本更低的模型，同时保持有用的定位质量。借助我们提出的 IssueLoc-Bench 基准，我们在相同的只读交互接口下评估了五个探索模型，测试涵盖 499 个源自 SWE-bench Verified 的任务以及来自另外 153 个代码仓库的 500 个任务。我们测量了早期候选发现、前三名金标准文件覆盖率、严格文件集恢复率、智能体耗时和 token 使用量，并进行了配对的实例级不确定性分析以及按仓库聚类的敏感性分析。质量最高的探索模型在各项定位指标上均处于领先地位，但也涌现出成本显著更低的使用方案：根据模型和评估设置的不同，成本更低的探索模型能够保留参考模型约 78-94% 的 Hit@3 和 73-92% 的 F1，同时降……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究提出 IssueLoc-Bench 基准，证明编码智能体流水线中成本高昂的仓库探索阶段可以交给更便宜的模型完成，同时保留参考模型约 78-94% 的定位质量（Hit@3），从而大幅降低成本。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces IssueLoc-Bench and demonstrates that the costly repository exploration stage of coding-agent pipelines can be delegated to cheaper models while retaining about 78-94% of the reference model's localization quality (Hit@3), substantially reducing cost.
